description:
This Thursday on VSRF LIVE: Vindicated! Courage Under Fire — Featuring Dr. Pete “Doc” Chambers and Dr. Kirk Moore, M.D.Show more This week, we are honored to welcome two extraordinary Americans whose names stand for courage, integrity, and an unwavering commitment to truth: Lt. Col. (Ret.) Pete “Doc” Chambers and Dr. Kirk Moore, M.D.
Dr. Pete “Doc” Chambers, a decorated Special Forces Green Beret and combat veteran, has spent his life protecting others—from the battlefield to the southern border. His principled leadership and deep sense of duty now fuel his campaign for Governor of Texas. In the wake of the recent tragic flooding, his experience and steady hand are needed now more than ever.
Dr. Kirk Moore, a respected plastic surgeon and former U.S. Navy Flight Surgeon, made recent national headlines when federal charges against him were dismissed by U.S. Attorney General Pam Bondi. Amid the rollout of oppressive COVID-19 vaccine mandates, Dr. Moore chose to honor the informed wishes of concerned patients and parents—administering saline instead of mRNA shots to healthy adults and children, and discarding federally distributed vaccines so individuals could retain their jobs, attend school, travel, and continue daily life without coercion. On X, Bondi stated:
“Dr. Moore gave his patients a choice when the federal government refused to do so. He did not deserve the years in prison he was facing.”
(Sources: Yahoo News, STAT, ABC News)
Both men upheld the sacred oath to first, do no harm. They stood firmly standing against coercion, censorship, and government overreach at great personal cost.
In this timely and compelling conversation, we’ll explore:
Their decades of military and medical service, and how these experiences shaped their stand for truth and transparency
The courageous decisions they made to protect patients over politics, at great personal risk
The mounting evidence of harms associated with COVID vaccines for both healthy children and adults
What their journeys reveal about the fight for informed consent, medical ethics, and liberty in America
This is more than a medical conversation—it’s a powerful testament to standing tall when the world demands compliance.
📺 Tune in Thursday at 7 PM ET / 4 PM PT
Streaming live on Rumble and X (@VSRFofficial)
Bring your friends. Bring your questions.
This is one episode you won’t want to miss.
